svg.title: Azores Countercurrent: section positions versus width
svg.desc: Primary indexed text describes positions about 100 and 250 km along a POSAF section. Their arithmetic difference is 150 km. The later 100 to 250 km width-range wording is a different interpretation. A current width or geographic boundary is not verified. Full primary figure and methods remain unreviewed.

g.text: Azores Countercurrent / what the numbers locate
POSAF temporal mean, February-June 1999 / 500-1200 dbar context
Section-distance coordinate (km); origin and geographic mapping unreviewed
The primary passage describes the mean westward maximum's section positions.
Physical width and width error remain unknown; no velocity boundaries or annual range admitted.
Primary: Alves et al. (2002), indexed discussion / Fig.9 caption; full original unreviewed.
Secondary: Carracedo et al. (2012), pp.278-279. OSW source-meaning comparison, no curve digitization.
